description.en: Intended to fully restore the TP (Technique Points) gauge of every party member at once, mirroring CMND_TEAM_GP_RECV_ALL. In this build its native implementation only validates the call and returns — it doesn't actually touch any party member's TP, so calling it currently has no gameplay effect.
True on any valid call (the function is otherwise a no-op); null if the call was invalid.
